name: The Death Of A Baby
overview: Scripture reveals that God intimately knows and values every life, having formed each person in the womb and ordained their purpose even before birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5 and Psalms 139:13. In the face of the death of a baby, believers are assured of God's comforting presence through the darkest trials, with His rod and staff providing solace (Psalms 23:4) and His nearness to the brokenhearted offering salvation (Psalms 34:18). God promises strength and help to those who mourn, affirming that they will be comforted (Isaiah 41:10; Matthew 5:4).
